ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will stop a salesperson from declining a transaction. Excludes profiles for: NF-CAO, Sys Admin, Outsource Processor, Ops User, and NF Credit API (This rule may no longer be necessary due to Oppty_Stage_Restrictions_Merchant_Sales)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),'Statements In - MCA')), AND( $Profile.Name != 'FPC - Operations User', $Profile.Name != 'NF - CAO', $Profile.Name != 'NF - Outsource Processor - WC', $Profile.Name != 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name != 'NF Credit API', $Profile.Name != 'FPC - Chief Credit Officer', $Profile.Name != 'Services Profile' ), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Declined'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Internal Decline'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'NF Decline') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Your user profile does not allow you to select the Decline, Internal Decline or NF Decline stage. Please update the Stage to save.
